prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1106; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the parking lot collision you reported in Sugar Land. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened.

A: I was pulling into a parking space near the entrance of the shopping center. I had just turned in from the access road and was going slowly, maybe five miles an hour.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. It came out from the row across from me, backing up. I saw a flash of movement and then I hit the brakes, but there was contact on my front passenger side.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?

A: I felt a stiffness in my lower back right away, but I thought it would pass. It got worse over the next day or so.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the following morning. They said I had a back strain and gave me a referral for physical therapy.

Q: Are you currently taking any medication or attending therapy sessions?

A: I'm doing therapy twice a week and taking an over-the-counter pain reliever when needed.

Q: Did you have any prior problems with your lower back?

A: No, nothing that required treatment. I'd had occasional soreness after long days at work, but nothing like this.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the collision?

A: Just that I was careful and the other driver seemed to be in a hurry. I'd like to get this resolved so I can get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
